name: A-Level 学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 2 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 15 分钟（含片头片尾）
鼓励剧情片、纪录片、实验短片等多元类型
需提交完整剧本及分镜脚本
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 2 works
Each film must not exceed 15 minutes including opening and credits
Narrative, documentary and experimental forms are all encouraged
A complete script and storyboard must be submitted

name: AP 学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 2 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 15 分钟（含片头片尾）
鼓励剧情片、纪录片、实验短片等多元类型
需提交完整剧本及分镜脚本
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 2 works
Each film must not exceed 15 minutes including opening and credits
Narrative, documentary and experimental forms are all encouraged
A complete script and storyboard must be submitted

name: IB 学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 2 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 12 分钟（含片头片尾）
题材不限，鼓励跨学科主题探索
需提交完整剧本及创作反思
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 2 works
Each film must not exceed 12 minutes including opening and credits
All themes are welcome, especially interdisciplinary ideas
A complete script and creative reflection must be submitted

name: 普通高中学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 1 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 10 分钟（含片头片尾）
题材不限，鼓励关注校园生活与社会议题
需提交简要创作说明
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 1 work
Each film must not exceed 10 minutes including opening and credits
All themes are welcome, especially school life and social issues
A brief creative statement must be submitted

name: 初中学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 1 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 8 分钟（含片头片尾）
鼓励短片、Vlog、微纪录片等形式
需提交简要创作说明
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 1 work
Each film must not exceed 8 minutes including opening and credits
Short films, vlogs and mini documentaries are encouraged
A brief creative statement must be submitted

name: 小学学段
requirements: 每班至少提交 1 部作品
单部作品时长不超过 5 分钟（含片头片尾）
形式自由，可为动画、定格或真人短片
鼓励家长或老师给予适度协助
requirementsEn: Each class should submit at least 1 work
Each film must not exceed 5 minutes including opening and credits
Animation, stop-motion and live action are all welcome
Parents and teachers may provide moderate support
